CORRECTION
energy-claim-09
17 Oct 2026 · 21:23 UTC

Our earlier wording assigned the people-specific 31 March footnote to generator units. Remove that unsupported cutoff; keep both accurate reported counts and the unresolved difference. The comparison note and April timeline wording are corrected too.

energy-revision-2 → energy-revision-3

EARLIER WORDING
UNHCR reported 186 generators distributed during the winter period in its July monitoring report, compared with 420 planned. Its April update had reported 110 as of 31 March 2025.

Status: Supported by cited source

Limits
The later figure is 44.29% of the original generator target. The July box has no separate cutoff date and does not explain the difference from April. Generators are distinct from the 2,400 planned portable power stations; no delivered power-station total was found in the reviewed documents.

Plan p. 1, alternative energy; April update p. 4, Generators row; July monitoring p. 4, Alternative Energy Support box.

Sources: UNHCR · UNHCR · UNHCR

CORRECTED WORDING
UNHCR's April 2025 report lists 110 generators; its July monitoring report lists 186 distributed during the winter period, against 420 planned.

Status: Supported by cited source

Limits
The reports differ by 76 units without explaining the change. The April footnote dates people reached, not generator units; neither report supplies a separate comparable generator cutoff. Additional deliveries, changed coverage and revised records remain unconfirmed explanations. No delivered portable-power-station total was established.

Plan p. 1, alternative energy; April update p. 4, Generators row and people-specific footnote; July monitoring p. 4, Alternative Energy Support box.

Sources: UNHCR · UNHCR · UNHCR

Sources for this change: UNHCR · UNHCR · UNHCR
